fact: A General Procurement Notice under the AfDB-financed BRIDGE project invites bids (deadline 7 October 2026) for a one-stop-shop digital platform integrating all GIEPA e-services, i.e. the platform is being procured.
title: General Procurement Notice for Development of One-Stop-Shop Digital Platform Integrating All Giepa E-Services
publisher: African Development Bank / Government of The Gambia (via TenderDetail)
